Frequently Asked Questions

How long does the hair color last?

The longevity of the color varies depending on hair type, condition, and the frequency of washing. 

 

Generally, our innovative formula ensures your vibrant color lasts 6-8 weeks, allowing for a seamless, natural-looking fade over time.
How long does a bottle last?

One bottle is designed to last for approximately 10 to 15 applications, depending on hair length and thickness.

Is it safe on my hair?

Absolutely! Our shampoo is formulated with natural ingredients and without harsh chemicals, making it safe for all hair types. 

 

It's gentle on your hair and scalp, ensuring not just color but also care.

Will it cover my gray hair completely?

Yes, our shampoo is specifically designed to cover gray hair thoroughly, offering a uniform, natural black shade. Continuous use will enhance the color depth and coverage.

Can it be used on dyed or chemically treated hair?

Yes, our shampoo is safe for use on dyed or chemically treated hair. However, we recommend doing a patch test or consulting with a professional if you have concerns about your specific hair condition.

Does this shampoo leave stains on skin or fabric?

Absolutely not! Our shampoo is designed for worry-free use, with a formula that rinses clean away without leaving any residue or stains on your skin, shower, or fabrics.

 

You won't need any protective equipment or special precautions—just apply, lather, and rinse as you would with any regular shampoo for a clean, effortless experience.

Can I use this shampoo on my beard?

Yes, you can!  Our shampoo is perfectly safe and effective for use on your beard, offering the same natural-looking, vibrant black color and nourishing benefits as it does for your hair.
